findings: Twelve original geometry views inspected, then all twelve rechecked after the light revision. Cyberdeck case supports two display stanchions, housing and screen; keyboard and maker board lie on top plate. Approximately 15 cm wide, illustrative dimensions.

Studio light connects through a tilt yoke to telescoping stand and three equally spaced grounded feet with braces. Pivot spans were extended into the lamp body and foot contacts aligned before the first inspected scene.

Modifier diameter approximately 58 cm and depth 32.7 cm follow manufacturer reference scale. Stand shortened from roughly 1.84 m overall to 1.34 m overall; oblique camera reveals modifier shell rather than a mirror-like frontal circle. No physics simulation or load certification claimed.
Five native cards, nine accepted/Noto references and ten final IconManager variants inspected. Other four source hashes remained unchanged after the light revision.
Three original flat symbols cover comics critique, fiction writing and library-card signup. Manufacturer images informed construction but were not traced; no workshop kit or issued card reproduced.
